versions.changelog: Makes daily practice cards language-neutral and explicitly marks the Chinese one-minute case as an illustrative localized example. Real responses always follow the language of the user's current request.

Rebuilds Stoic Coach as a low-friction daily practice with one-minute control checks, morning previews, evening reviews, and situation exercises. Adds practical templates and safety boundaries while keeping reflections conversation-only by default.
Single-file review-safe Stoic reflection core with explicit activation examples and a narrow conversation-only scope.
